PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): settle once for boards 01-06, before any is drawn live (every SCR-030 board copies this column, §0 L37-38): either (a) §4.1 L235 adds 'on the 40-row base boards 13:35's POC follows `24` §4.5 over its 40 rows (63,998.0); §4.7 L329 / L349 and §8.1 L731 read the five-level column of boards 20-26' (what this board draws), or (b) the base boards draw 13:35 as §4.1's five traded levels, as boards 20 and 22 do (§3 L193 calls 'every row traded' an upper bound): 9 × 40 + 5 = 365 cells still fill the 10 × 40 grid, POC 64,011.0 (289 BTC), value area 64,010.0–64,012.0, one ×3 buy stack and a low ledge under 64,009.0 (the high one clips at the plot's top); the Budget and Notes counts change.

Pressed states carry a CMP-019 `check` glyph (size.icon, ink) before the label, the selected fill kept as reinforcement: [FP] (the glyph stands for the sketch's '*', §4.1 L215), Chart (E11-D04 D1 L114, L139: E11-D02 D8's selected fill + check glyph) and the cluster's auto (E11-D02 D8 L115, §7.2 L267: the glyph is the ≥ 3:1 state carrier, the fill reinforcement, L493-495); §8.3 L771 and the build notes forbid a colour-only signal. The kit's ctl() and time_strip() draw the fill alone, so gen_03 adds the glyph (e18kit.py not edited). Not drawn: the color.border.strong reinforcement edge (not a wireframe grey) and the options' own glyphs icon/chart-candles and icon/table (E11-D04 L139, registry request CR-D04-3; the words carry the options).

The time strip's cluster is three segments 24 px high at y 0 of the 24 px strip, each at least 24 px wide (E11-D02 §2 L93: 24 × 24 at dense; rule 3, L233: dense never shrinks a target below 24 px; `05` §3.4 item 7): auto (with its check glyph), fit and the third, E11-D02's `›` ("Latest", L72, L115, L291), drawn as the CMP-019 chevron-right glyph where §4.1's ASCII sketch writes '>' (L227). The kit's time_strip() draws 20 px pill-high segments and a '>' text, so gen_03 resizes and swaps them (e18kit.py not edited).

Kit chrome kept for consistency with the other boards (the kit owner's to change): the toolbar, status and strip rows use dense's legend type (type.ui.caption, E11-D02 L218), where L84 says the DOM chrome is compact at dense.
The strip row (S) is drawn on color.surface.raised, empty when idle (E12-D02 L75); the kit's strip_row() fills it with the paper, so gen_03 sets the fill (e18kit.py not edited).

Four compositions carry the build notes' '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)' names, which the kit does not give them: CMP-223 DrawingToolbar (the rail, E14-D02's tools not drawn), CMP-188 PriceAxis, CMP-189 TimeAxis and CMP-003 SegmentedControl · Chart | Table (`15` L69, L2220, L2233, L2610; E11-D04 D1 L114); gen_03 renames them (e18kit.py not edited).
The 12:50 bar has no time label: its label would start left of the UTC clock's exclusion zone (E11-D02 L172: 8 px right of the tag), so the kit drops it.

At dense the candle strip draws the 1 px wick only (D3 L153; §3 L179): every bar trades all 40 rows, so each wick spans the pane and no body is drawn (bars.mjs's, or §4.1's ▌ rows on the anatomy bars); the kit's 'candles' line about filled bodies applies at compact and comfortable.

Two cells read '…' (13:25 and 13:30 at 64,009.0): §4.1 L224 elides them; the generator's values there (13:25 118 × 79, 13:30 36 × 26) would flag the 64,010.0 ask above them (702 / 118 = 5.95, 201 / 36 = 5.58), outlines the sketch rows do not draw (L220-224). PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): §4.1 L224 hand-picks the two cells so the sketch rows gain no outline (13:25: bid 235–2,105, ask ≤ 185; 13:30: bid 68–602, ask ≤ 557; an ask ≥ 21 / ≥ 63 also keeps the 40-row boards' 64,008.0 bid unflagged), then the boards draw those values.
The base scene's 40 rows span 63,974.0-64,013.0: the top row is the forming bar's high as §4.1 draws it (L219-220, the cap above 64,013.0); §3 L192-194 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT but no prices.

Candle bodies of generator bars are bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) scaled into the 40-row window; every bar spans the window (§3 L193: every row traded), so the wick runs top to bottom; the body is filled (its form is E12-D06's, §4.1 D3).

Edge levels (no neighbour inside the bar) are not compared, as §4.1 draws its column (L233 'The three outlined cells'; the sketch outlines no edge, L220-224). `24` §4.2 (L792) treats a neighbour outside the traded range as zero volume under zero_policy treat_as_min, a fixed, unexposed default (spec §6.2 L535-536): all 20 edge sides here are non-zero (10 highs' bids, 10 lows' asks), so `24` would add 20 outlines (154, not 134), no new stack. PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): either an A-row to `24` §4.2 'edge levels are not compared' (what the boards draw), or the boards draw the 20 edge outlines and §4.1 L233's count is amended.

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A mark beyond the plot (the forming cap 1 px + 2 px above a column whose top is the window's top, an unfinished-auction ledge at the window's edge) is not drawn: §3's 40 rows fill the pane exactly.
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (32 px at dense: every 2 rows, 2.0 USDT) and, at dense, flush in the 48 px gutter with 0 px inner padding: '64,012.0' in type.num.xs is 8 × 6 = 48 px, the whole gutter (§3 L177's floor), so E11-D02 §2's 4 px padding (L90) cannot hold; gen_03 places each label at x = max(0, 48 − 4 − width) (the kit's price_gutter() starts it at x −4, 4 px into the plot; e18kit.py not edited). PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): the dense price-gutter width: §3 L177 plans the 48 px floor, E11-D02 L91 sizes the gutter 'widest label + 8, min 48', 56 px for '64,012.0' (48 px); at 56 px the plot is 1,200 px, its free margin 30 px, and neither 13:35 short label (36 + 2 px) fits.
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
